# IT313 Enrollment Eligibility Checker (TypeScript Version)

## Problem Description
A fully-typed TypeScript port of the IT313 Registrar Enrollment Eligibility Checker[cite: 10]. It calculates individual grade averages, categorizes status using Enums, and generates an eligibility summary[cite: 10, 11].

## TypeScript Concepts Applied
- **Enums (`EnrollmentStatus`)**: Ensures status values are strictly `Passing` or `Probation` instead of arbitrary strings[cite: 11].
- **Interfaces (`Enrollee`, `EligibilityReport`)**: Defines precise structural contracts for student record data and report objects[cite: 10, 11].
- **Optional Properties (`remarks?`)**: Allows optional field handling for students needing consultation[cite: 11].
- **Union Types & Narrowing (`string | number`)**: Demonstrates `typeof` type narrowing prior to string manipulation[cite: 11].
- **Generics (`groupBy<T>`)**: Created a reusable type-safe grouping utility function[cite: 11].
- **Strict Mode Compilation**: Guaranteed clean type checks using `npx tsc --noEmit`[cite: 11].
